children: CEA Industries reported a first-quarter fiscal 2027 net loss of $11.4 million, or $(0.22) per diluted share, driven primarily by a $15.3 million unrealized loss on digital assets. The company held 515,544 BNB tokens with a fair value of approximately $302.3 million at July 31, 2026, and digital assets represented 93.1% of total assets. During the quarter CEA repurchased 1,434,112 shares for $3.8 million and ended the period with $7.1 million in cash and cash equivalents.
Net loss: $11.4 million, or $(0.22) per basic and diluted share for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.
Unrealized loss on digital assets: $15.3 million (of which $15.0 million related to BNB).
Revenue (Retail and Industry segment): $7.2 million for the quarter; gross profit: $2.0 million.
Digital asset fair value: 515,544 BNB tokens valued at $302.3 million; total digital assets fair value $304.5 million, representing 93.1% of total assets.
Liquidity and debt: Cash and cash equivalents $7.1 million; total debt outstanding $16.8 million; drew $15.0 million USDC under master loan facility secured by 44,198 BNB.
Shareholder activism resolved via a cooperation agreement with YZILabs; Board expanded with three appointments and a seventh mutually agreed director pending.

Leadership changes: Carly E. Howard named Chair; Alex Odagiu serving as Interim President; William B. Miller added Interim Principal Executive Officer duties while continuing as CFO; CEO search ongoing.
Nasdaq compliance restored following the July 22, 2026 special meeting; Nasdaq notified the company on August 5, 2026 that the listing deficiency matter is closed.
Asset Management Agreement litigation is pending in the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware; motion to dismiss filed by Asset Manager and opposition filed by the company.

Retail operations: Fat Panda operated 34 retail locations across Central Canada (30 Fat Panda stores and 4 Electric Fog outlets), plus e-commerce platform and in-house premium e-liquid manufacturing; a product line discontinuation at Fat Panda contributed to the slight revenue decline year-over-year for the segment.
